claims.object_text: direct ATM/ATR substrate and phosphorylation changes
claims.quote: Profiles of global proteome and phosphoproteomics - both direct ATM/ATR substrates and overall phosphorylation changes - confirmed previous findings for NBN, MRE11, MDC1, CHEK1, EIF4EBP1, AP3B2, PPP2R5C, SYN1 and SLC2A1.
